articles.text: PROTOCOL DEPARTMENT: Hello. This is the Protocol Department.
MÌSHŪ: Wèi, wǒ shi Láidēng Dàshǐde mìshū.
SECRETARY: Hello. I am Ambassador Leyden's secretary.
MÌSHŪ: Dàshǐ jiēzháo nǐmende qǐngtiě le.
SECRETARY: The ambassador received your invitation.
MÌSHŪ: Hěn kěxī, yīnwei tā yǒu shì, Bāyuè jiǔhào bù néng lái.
SECRETARY: Unfortunately, because he has a previous engagement, he cannot come on August 9.
MÌSHŪ: Qǐng ni zhuǎngào Qiáo Bùzhǎng. Hěn bàoqiàn.
SECRETARY: Please inform Minister Qiáo. I'm very sorry.
LǏBĪNSĪ: Hěn yíhàn, Láidēng Dàshǐ bù néng lái.
PROTOCOL DEPARTMENT: We very much regret that Ambassador Leyden cannot come.
LǏBĪNSĪ: Wǒ tì ni zhuǎngào yíxià.
PROTOCOL DEPARTMENT: I will pass on the message for you.
MÌSHŪ: Xièxie. Xīwàng yǐhòu zài zhǎo jīhui jùyijù ba.
SECRETARY: Thank you. I hope we'll find another chance to get together later.
